```{r Datentabelle, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

# Import Data from a the SQLite database

 query.dxi.val <- "SELECT DISTINCT
                        a.Werte AS DxI800,
                        MAX(d.DoseResult_c) AS DxI9000,
                        a.Bezeichnung,
                        a.Methode,
                        m.EINHEIT AS Einheit_800,
                        d.DoseUnit AS Einheit_9000,
                        d.Probennummer
                      FROM MeasurementData a
                        JOIN MethodData m ON a.Methode = m.Methode
                        JOIN TranslationData t ON a.Methode = t.Methode
                        JOIN DxIvalData d 
                            ON t.TestOrderCode = d.TestOrderCode
                            AND a.Probennummer = d.Probennummer 
                      WHERE a.Methode = '%s' 
                        AND d.DoseResult <> 'No result'
                      GROUP BY a.Probennummer;"
    
    # Fetch data from the database
    validation.data <- NULL
    validation.data <- dbGetQuery(con, sprintf(query.dxi.val, method))
    # convert data to numeric
    validation.data[,1] <- as.numeric(validation.data[,1])
    # validation.data[,2] <- as.numeric(validation.data[,2])
    
    # omit rows with NA values
    validation.data <- na.omit(validation.data)
    
```

## Präzision

```{r intra_and_inter_assay_coefficient_of_variability, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)

nameQuery <- sprintf("SELECT TestName FROM TranslationData WHERE Methode = '%s'", method)
name <- dbGetQuery(con, nameQuery)[1, 1]

# enable and register the REGEXP function in the SQLite connection
initExtension(con, extension = "regexp")

# SQL query for intra- and inter-assay precision data
query.L <- sprintf("SELECT 
                        d.TestName, 
                        d.TestCompleteDT, 
                        d.SampleID,
                        q.Level,
                        CAST(d.DoseResult_c AS FLOAT) AS DoseResult, 
                        d.DoseUnit, 
                        d.Einheit_800,
                        q.Zielwert,
                        q.LotNr,
                        q.maxDate,
                        q.minDate
                  FROM DxIvalData d
                  JOIN TranslationData t ON d.TestOrderCode = t.TestOrderCode
                  JOIN QCData q ON q.Parameter = t.RemisolCode
                  WHERE d.TestName = '%s' 
                    AND d.SampleID REGEXP '[a-zA-Z]+1' --_\\d'
                    AND d.DoseUnit IS NOT NULL
                    AND q.Level = 1
                    --AND d.TestCompleteDT <= q.maxDate --AND d.TestCompleteDT >= q.minDate
                  --GROUP BY
                    --d.TestCompleteDT
                  ;", name)

query.H <- sprintf("SELECT 
                        d.TestName, 
                        d.TestCompleteDT, 
                        d.SampleID,
                        q.Level,
                        CAST(d.DoseResult_c AS FLOAT) AS DoseResult, 
                        d.DoseUnit, 
                        d.Einheit_800,
                        q.Zielwert,
                        q.LotNr,
                        q.maxDate,
                        q.minDate
                  FROM DxIvalData d
                  JOIN TranslationData t ON d.TestOrderCode = t.TestOrderCode
                  JOIN QCData q ON q.Parameter = t.RemisolCode
                  WHERE d.TestName = '%s' 
                    AND d.SampleID REGEXP '[a-zA-Z]+2' --_\\d'
                    AND d.DoseUnit IS NOT NULL
                    AND q.Level = 2
                    --AND d.TestCompleteDT <= q.maxDate --AND d.TestCompleteDT >= q.minDate
                  --GROUP BY
                    --d.TestCompleteDT
                  ;", name)

# execute both queries
prc.L.data <- dbGetQuery(con, query.L) |> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(TestCompleteDT, format = "%m-%d-%Y"),
         maxDate = as.Date(maxDate, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) |> 
  filter(Date <= maxDate & Date >= minDate)

prc.H.data <- dbGetQuery(con, query.H)|> 
  mutate(Date = as.Date(TestCompleteDT, format = "%m-%d-%Y"),
         maxDate = as.Date(maxDate, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) |> 
  filter(Date <= maxDate & Date >= minDate)

# define data processing function
prc.data.fun <- function(prc.L.data, prc.H.data){

  #transform prc.L.data
  prc.L.data <-  prc.L.data |>  group_by(Date) |> slice_head(n = 5) |> ungroup()
  

  #transform prc.H.data
  prc.H.data <-  prc.H.data |>  group_by(Date) |> slice_head(n = 5) |> ungroup()
  
  # check the row numbers
  if(nrow(prc.L.data) >= 25 | nrow(prc.H.data) >= 25){
    # select the first 25 rows = precision data
    prc.L.data <- head(prc.L.data, 25)
    prc.H.data <- head(prc.H.data, 25)
    
    # proceed with table creation
    prc.table.fun(prc.L.data, prc.H.data)
  } else {
    # return an error message
    message("Not enough data available for precision analysis")
    return(NULL)
  }
}

prc.table.fun <- function(prc.L.data, prc.H.data){
 
    # building the CLSIEP15 table
    L.long <- data.frame(
      rep = rep(1:5, each = 5),
      name = paste(prc.L.data$SampleID[1:25], rep(1:5, each = 5), sep = "_"),
      value = prc.L.data$DoseResult[1:25],
      Zielwert = prc.L.data$Zielwert[1:25]
    )
    
    H.long <- data.frame(
      rep = rep(1:5, each = 5),
      name = paste(prc.H.data$SampleID[1:25], rep(1:5, each = 5), sep = "_"),
      value = prc.H.data$DoseResult[1:25],
      Zielwert = prc.H.data$Zielwert[1:25]
    )
    
    # prec.intra.L <- L.long |> 
    #   group_by(rep) |>
    #   summarise(N = n(),
    #             mean = mean(value),
    #             sd = sd(value),
    #             CVR = sd(value) / mean(value) * 100,
    #             Zielwert = mean(Zielwert))
    
     library(CLSIEP15)
     prc.data.L <- calculate_aov_infos(L.long)
     prc.data.H <- calculate_aov_infos(H.long)
     bias.L <- calculate_bias_interval('E', 
                                       nrun = prc.data.L$N/prc.data.L$k, 
                                       nrep = prc.data.L$k, 
                                       SWL = prc.data.L$SWL, 
                                       SR = prc.data.L$SR, 
                                       nsamples = 2, 
                                       expected_mean = prc.L.data$Zielwert[c(1, 25)], 
                                       user_mean = prc.data.L$mean)

    bias.H <- calculate_bias_interval('E', 
                                      nrun = prc.data.H$N/prc.data.H$k, 
                                      nrep = prc.data.H$k, 
                                      SWL = prc.data.H$SWL, 
                                      SR = prc.data.H$SR, 
                                      nsamples = 2, 
                                      expected_mean = prc.H.data$Zielwert[c(1, 25)], 
                                      user_mean = prc.data.H$mean)
    # 
    # 
    # 
    # val.prec <- read_excel("vdata _DxI.xlsx", sheet = "PREC")
    
    intra.df <- data.frame(
      "Präzisionsdaten" = c("n intra & bias", "n inter", "Zielwert", "Untere Grenze", "Mittelwert", "SD",  "Obere Grenze", "Bias", "Intra Assay VK (%)", "Inter Assay VK (%)"),
      L = c(
        paste(prc.data.L$N),
        paste(prc.data.L$n),
        paste(min(prc.L.data$Zielwert), "|", max(prc.L.data$Zielwert)),
        paste(min(bias.L$interval$lower_limit), "|", max(bias.L$interval$lower_limit)),
        paste(round(prc.data.L$mean, 2) ),
        paste(round(prc.data.L$sd, 2) ),
        paste(min(bias.L$interval$higher_limit), "|", max(bias.L$interval$higher_limit)),
        paste(round(bias.L$bias[1], 2), "|", round(bias.L$bias[2], 2)),
        paste(round(prc.data.L$CVR, 2) ),
        paste(round(prc.data.L$CVWL, 2) )
      ),
      H = c(
        paste(prc.data.H$N),
        paste(prc.data.H$n),
        paste(min(prc.H.data$Zielwert), "|", max(prc.H.data$Zielwert)),
        paste(min(bias.H$interval$lower_limit), "|", max(bias.H$interval$lower_limit)),
        paste(round(prc.data.H$mean, 2) ),
        paste(round(prc.data.H$sd, 2) ),
        paste(min(bias.H$interval$higher_limit), "|", max(bias.H$interval$higher_limit)),
        paste(round(bias.H$bias[1], 2), "|", round(bias.H$bias[2], 2)),
        paste(round(prc.data.H$CVR, 2) ),
        paste(round(prc.data.H$CVWL, 2) )
      )
    )
    
    colnames(intra.df)[1] <- paste("Präzisionsdaten", name)
    
    # inter.df <- data.frame(
    #   "Inter Assay" = c("n", "Zielwert", "Mittelwert", "SD", "VK (%)"),
    #   L = c(
    #     paste(prc.data.L$n),
    #     paste(min(prc.L.data$Zielwert), "&", max(prc.L.data$Zielwert)),
    #     paste(round(prc.data.L$mean, 2) ),
    #     paste(round(prc.data.L$sd, 2) ),
    #     paste(round(prc.data.L$CVWL, 2) )
    #   ),
    #   H = c(
    #     paste(prc.data.H$n),
    #     paste(min(prc.H.data$Zielwert), "&", max(prc.H.data$Zielwert)),
    #     paste(round(prc.data.H$mean, 2) ),
    #     paste(round(prc.data.H$sd, 2) ),
    #     paste(round(prc.data.H$CVWL, 2) )
    #   )
    # )
    
    intra.df.ft <- flextable(intra.df)|> 
      align(align = "center", part = "all")|> 
      autofit()|>
      add_footer_lines("")|>
      bg(bg = "grey", part = "header")
    
    # inter.df.ft <- flextable(inter.df)
    # inter.df.ft <- align(inter.df.ft, align = "right", part = "all")
    # inter.df.ft <- autofit(inter.df.ft)    
    # inter.df.ft <- add_footer_lines(inter.df.ft, "")
    # inter.df.ft <- bg(inter.df.ft, bg = "grey", part = "header")
    
    # Return the tables so they can be rendered in the document
    list(intra = intra.df.ft#, inter = inter.df.ft
         )
}

ft <- prc.data.fun(prc.L.data, prc.H.data)
if(!is.null(ft$intra)){
  ft$intra
  }else{
  cat("Nicht genug Daten verfügbar für die Intra-Assay-Präzisionsanalyse")
}

#   }
```

```{r correlation, echo=FALSE, out.height = "80%", out.width = "80%"}
     xlab=colnames(validation.data)[1], ylab=colnames(validation.data)[2])
```

## Passing Bablok

<!-- Passing Bablok Plot mit Steigung, Achsenabschnitt, Spearman's correlation  -->

```{r PB, echo=FALSE, out.height = "80%", out.width = "80%"}

MCResult.plot(PB.reg, equal.axis = TRUE, x.lab = colnames(validation.data)[1], y.lab = colnames(validation.data)[2], points.col = "#68228B", points.pch = 19, ci.area = TRUE, ci.area.col = "#0000FF50", main = paste("Validation", colnames(validation.data)[2], "vs", colnames(validation.data)[1]), sub = "", add.cor = TRUE, cor.method = "spearman", add.grid = FALSE, points.cex = 1)
##Angabe Steigung und Achsenabschnitt und CI
intercept_est <- PB.reg@para[1]
intercept_lci <- PB.reg@para[5]
intercept_uci <- PB.reg@para[7]
gradient_est <- PB.reg@para[2]
gradient_lci <- PB.reg@para[6]
gradient_uci <- PB.reg@para[8]
alpha_ci <- PB.reg@alpha[1]
text(cex=.65,x=max(validation.data[,1:2])*0.8,y=max(validation.data[,1:2])*0.49,sprintf("Gradient : %4.2f (%4.2f - %4.2f)", gradient_est, gradient_lci, gradient_uci))
text(cex=.65,x=max(validation.data[,1:2])*0.8,y=max(validation.data[,1:2])*0.42,sprintf("Intercept : %4.2f (%4.2f - %4.2f)", intercept_est, intercept_lci, intercept_uci))
text(cex=.65,x=max(validation.data[,1:2])*0.8,y=max(validation.data[,1:2])*0.35, sprintf("alpha : %4.2f", alpha_ci))

```
